# Techo

Techo is a multilingual, voice-first business assistant for Indian small-business owners, e-commerce sellers, and aspiring entrepreneurs. Users talk to the assistant in Hinglish, Hindi, English, and 16 other Indian languages to manage sales, expenses, reminders, surveys, reviews, marketing, and customer outreach.

## Key Features

- Real-time voice interaction (Agora Conversational AI live sessions + Web Speech fallback)
- 18 supported Indian languages with language auto-detection and code-switching
- Business dashboard: sales & expenses, marketing studio, reminders & calls, surveys, reviews
- Integrations ("Give Your MCP a Voice"): Google Calendar scheduling, Resend email, Stripe read-only payments demo
- Human expert escalation for complex support cases
- Conversation history and privacy controls
